purpose: Sidecar classification for q/kdb+-style examples. Kept outside tests/manifest.json so manifest generation remains mechanical.

gate_profiles.core: Default q gate scope for in-memory q/qsql core semantics. Excludes dedicated IPC, session/workspace, and filesystem-backed persistence cases.
gate_profiles.extended: Explicit q gate scope for IPC/session/persistence surface cases that are correctness-owned outside the core progress denominator.

feature_matrix.benchmark_policy: semantic state/isolation surface; no perf-hot benchmark required
